title: Local tribal people told not to look toward the property

tellings.quote: their people have been told not even to look the direction of this property for generations.

plain: For generations, members of the local tribe on the Ute Ouray reservation in Utah have been told not even to look in the direction of a nearby ranch famous for reports of strange happenings. Brandon Fugal, the businessman who owns the ranch, passes this on as what he says the tribe's people told him around 2016, and he offers it as a sign that the land was feared long before anyone studied it.
